title: Checkpoint harness runner configuration
description: The run configuration sections `run` needs besides planning and dispatch (Task 3 research log §§4, 7 and §12 T3-E). run-config.schema.json validates planning, dispatch.schema.json roles, credentials and budgets; this schema requires both roles, the workspace roots, the write and approval permissions and the per-step retry budget. T3.5 H1 adds the optional verification section: where a candidate declares its bindings and how the run prepares its dependencies.

attempts.description: Production attempts per step, corrections included.

candidate_root.description: Directory for candidate, verifier and reviewer workspaces; never inside a run directory.

controller_root.description: Directory in which `run` creates its run directory.

approvers.description: The operator accounts that hold each approval authority a binding names.

verification.description: Production verification (T3.5 H1). Absent: only controller bindings, and no binding may need prepared dependencies.

bindings.description: Candidate directory holding one <binding-id>.yml declaration per binding a capability delivers; each counts only after admission.

dependencies.description: How dependencies are prepared for bindings that declare them: command runs in a contained workspace holding only the candidate's inputs paths, and its outputs are mounted read-only into subject workspaces.

network.description: none, or bridge when the operator lets the preparation fetch packages; candidate commands never have network.
